The '''Zi'Dek system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was one of the systems in the logs of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] located at the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison]]. Former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used to make smuggling runs through the system.
